author: felicepantaleo
body: Phase2 FastSim is a `phase2_hgcal` process that loads no Alpaka backend and runs no HGCal reco, so scheduling the `@alpaka` TICLGeom EventSetup producers made the EventProcessor fail to find the plugin at construction.
title: TICLGeom: do not schedule the @alpaka geometry ES producers in FastSim
